rows.note: This is the colloquial choice for how deep something is, especially water or a hole, rather than a measured specification.

example.english: We don't know the depth of this puddle, so don't go so close.
example.traditional: 呢個水氹唔知深淺，你唔好行咁埋。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 seoi2 tam5 m4 zi1 sam1 cin2 nei5 m4 hou2 haang4 gam3 maai4

rows.note: This is the all-purpose, more formal choice for measured physical depth, front-to-back dimensions, or abstract depth and complexity.

example.english: The report states that the pool's depth is two metres.
example.traditional: 報告列明個泳池深度係兩米。
example.jyutping: bou3 gou3 lit6 ming4 go3 wing6 ci4 sam1 dou6 hai6 loeng5 mai5

rows.note: Use this for the degree or extent of an emotion, problem, or other serious situation.

example.english: I only realized the depth of the problem today.
example.traditional: 我今日先知件事嚴重到咁嘅程度。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 sin1 zi1 gin6 si6 jim4 zung6 dou3 gam3 ge3 cing4 dou6
